charging_screen.what_is_quantified: Traction-only winter energy, 90% charging efficiency and average site-wide power for an eight-hour window.

binding_limits: The 300-km range screen leaves blocks over 300 km and requires recharge or vehicle exchange.
Original source-block chains fail the declared uniform transfer screen for thousands of connections.
Traction-only full-city energy is hundreds of MWh per day; site-specific charging feasibility is absent.
Capacity proxies do not supply trip-level payload or accessible-vehicle compatibility.
interpretation: All departures are retained and exact-class interval concurrency is below the scenario inventory. That is only a necessary condition. The absent vehicle, depot, charger, power, payload and winter records prevent a city-wide PASS.
